newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: CA 96 profit up, record Q1 97 earnings.
newsitem.headline: CA 96 profit up, record Q1 97 earnings.

text.p: Austria's Creditanstalt, presenting its last full-year results as an independent bank, reported a rise in 1996 net profit on Wednesday and said it achieved a record operating result in the first quarter 1997.
In a statement, Creditanstalt said 1996 group net profit increased to 2.93 billion schillings ($242.5 million) from 2.166 billion, clearing the way for a two schillings hike in the dividend to 12.
Group operating profit reached 19.331 billion schillings after 17.342.
International business had contributed around one third of group operating profit in 1996 and more than one third of net profit, Creditanstalt said.

The bank, taken over by market leader Bank Austria in January, said the positive trend continued in the first quarter of this year when group operating profit jumped to 2.2 billion schillings from 1.61 billion.
"The consolidated operating result in the first quarter recahed an all time high. In 1997, profit after taxes is likely to rise for the fifth year in succession," Creditanstalt said.

It traced the improvement in the first three months to strong trading earnings. 1997 full-year net profit would benefit from cost-cutting and lower charges for credit provisions, the bank said. ($ = 12.08 Austrian Schillings)
